set.61: Guest check-in, carried out remotely in compliance with the Italian legislation in force on guest identification, including the obligation of in-person (de visu) identification, also by means of remote identification tools compliant with such legislation and a video surveillance system installed outside the entrance of the Property, at the Principal’s care and expense and in compliance with data protection legislation; sending the access instructions and the guide referred to in letter a) of this paragraph; as well as collecting the tourist tax, issuing the related receipt and acquiring the identity documents of the guests for the communication to the Police;

set.90: The rent for each short-term rental is set by the Property Manager using dynamic pricing, according to the season, demand, the number of occupants and the length of stay. Before management begins, the Parties agree in writing on a minimum nightly price, based on the actual costs of the Property and its market positioning, below which the Property Manager may not go without the Principal’s prior consent. The minimum price may be updated at any time in writing, including by e-mail.
set.92: All costs relating to the Property, including condominium charges, waste tax, utilities (electricity, gas, water, internet, etc.) and any other tax or duty relating to the Property, are borne by the Principal. The Property Manager does not bear any cost relating to the Property.
set.128: The start-up activities carried out by the Property Manager (by way of example: photo shoot, creation and optimisation of listings, initial administrative procedures, fitting-out advice) have a conventionally agreed value of EUR 500.00 (five hundred/00) plus VAT. This amount is not due from the Principal, except in the event of early termination of the Agreement before 1 (one) year has elapsed from its signature, as provided for in Article 15.
set.155: “On-Site Intervention” means a visit to the Property by the Property Manager or by staff appointed by it, outside the scheduled activities (check-in, cleaning, check-out). In the event of problems with the Guests’ access to the Property, the Property Manager guarantees that the On-Site Intervention is carried out as soon as possible, compatibly with the time technically needed to reach the Property.
set.156: The Property Manager guarantees, at no additional cost to the Principal, 1 (one) On-Site Intervention per month for the routine inspection of the Property. Each additional On-Site Intervention, including those relating to the initial fitting-out and furnishing of the Property, attendance during renovation or maintenance works, or any other work relating to the Property, costs EUR 50.00 (fifty/00) plus VAT per visit, plus any out-of-pocket costs strictly necessary (by way of example: a locksmith to open the door, duplication of keys), without prejudice to the following paragraphs for On-Site Interventions made necessary by problems with Guest access. The repair or replacement of locks, cylinders or access devices is governed by Article 12, unless it becomes necessary due to the Property Manager or the staff appointed by it, in which case it is borne by the Property Manager.
set.168: The Property Manager undertakes to take out an insurance policy covering the risks connected with its activity and to send a copy to the Principal by a subsequent e-mail.
set.169: The Principal declares that he/she has taken out an adequate insurance policy with a leading insurer covering the risks of fire (building and contents), theft, and third-party liability towards tenants and third parties, which is attached to this agreement (annex d).
set.175: The Parties agree on a minimum term of the Agreement of 6 (six) months from the date of signature. Therefore, notice of withdrawal may not be given before 4 (four) months have elapsed from signature; any notice received before that date shall be deemed received on the day following its expiry. In any event, the Agreement may not end by withdrawal before 6 (six) months have elapsed from its signature. If the Agreement ends due to the Principal’s withdrawal, or due to termination for breach by the Principal, before 1 (one) year has elapsed from signature, the Principal shall pay the Property Manager the flat-rate reimbursement of start-up costs of EUR 500.00 (five hundred/00) plus VAT referred to in Article 10.
set.176: The flat-rate reimbursement referred to in the previous paragraph is not due if the Agreement ends due to the Property Manager’s withdrawal or due to termination for breach by the Property Manager. It may be withheld from the sums to be paid to the Principal under Article 9.
